content.title: About
content.content: American nonfat cheese is a processed cheese made from skim milk, emulsifiers, salt, and flavorings. It has a smooth, creamy texture, a mild buttery taste, and is commonly used in sandwiches, burgers, and as a topping.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Nonfat American cheese contains less than 0.5% fat.
It is a staple in fast‑food kitchens because it melts quickly and stays stable when heated.
The cheese got its name from the city of Wisconsin, where large‑scale processed cheese production began in the early 1900s.
It often includes added vitamin A and calcium, though in lower amounts than full‑fat cheese.
The low‑fat version is less prone to rancidity, giving it a longer shelf life.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Provides about 20 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Contains roughly 500 mg of calcium per 100 g, important for bone health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Suitable for low‑fat diets and helps control overall calorie intake.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Supplies vitamin B12 and riboflavin, which are essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Easily digestible
items.content: The processed nature makes it quick to digest, convenient for sensitive stomachs.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to dairy proteins or lactose may react to this cheese.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Contains up to 800 mg of salt per 100 g, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Additives and preservatives
items.content: Emulsifiers and flavorings are common and can cause intolerance in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Low vitamin D
items.content: Unlike full‑fat cheese, the nonfat version provides little vitamin D.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Slice for sandwiches, melt on burgers, stir into omelets, casseroles, and sauces. It melts in seconds in the microwave, making it a quick topping.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 2‑4 °C in the original wrapper or an airtight container. Once opened, use within 2‑3 weeks. Discard if you notice off‑smells, mold, or discoloration.
